title: SWREDU=2 Boesten-Stroosnijder production admission

frozen_science.state_atomicity: SPEV and SAEV are one option-specific committed/restart pair.
frozen_science.drying_branch: if wetting_rate < peva: spev1=spev0+(peva-wetting_rate)*dt; saev1=spev1 when spev1<cofred^2 else cofred*sqrt(spev1); empreva=wetting_rate+(saev1-saev0)/dt
frozen_science.rewetting_branch: if wetting_rate >= peva: empreva=peva; saev1=max(0,saev0-(wetting_rate-peva)*dt); spev1=saev1 when saev1<cofred^2 else (saev1/cofred)^2
frozen_science.mass_ownership: empreva and SPEV/SAEV deltas are not water-mass owners. Accepted actual surface evaporation remains owned by the hydraulic dynamic-top boundary.
frozen_science.rollback: Rejected hydraulic trials discard the complete candidate pair; changed-dt retry starts from the identical committed pair.

bounded_input_profile.reason: Legacy read authority permits 0..1, but the exact SWREDU=2 rewetting branch contains (saev/cofred)^2. At cofred=0 and a zero-consistent state this is 0/0. This production slice narrows admission instead of inventing repaired physics.

architecture_binding.process_state_rule: SPEV/SAEV remain a distinct process continuation pair, not hydraulic fields or worker scratch.
architecture_binding.transaction_state: Introduce a separate option-discriminated FMR state family for SWREDU=2; do not overload the Black state layout.
architecture_binding.top_boundary: Reuse the admitted dynamic top-boundary solver provider inside each trial with Boesten demand evaluated from that trial checkpoint and dt.
architecture_binding.forcing: Reuse PPA-WU03 raw precipitation plus resolved surface irrigation as the net wetting-rate input under SWINTER=0. No hidden calendar or source cursor is introduced.
architecture_binding.restart: Reuse generic committed restart with an explicit Boesten optional-state-layout identity; reject BASE/Black/Boesten family mismatch.
architecture_binding.solver_policy: No solver equations, retry policy, solver selection, RossFast internals or groundwater coupling semantics may change.

qualification_gates: exact source-equation oracle for drying, rewetting and ponding branches
changed-dt retry equals direct retry from the same committed pair
production delta limited to preregistered ownership surface
